primaryStory.label: Chart Story
primaryStory.text: After a controlled pullback into the rising 20-day average, buyers have started to push price higher again, but the rebound still needs follow-through.

interpreterResponse.currentRisk: The rebound could fail if buyers cannot add follow-through and price slips back below the 20-day average.

finalProse.chartStory: After a controlled pullback into the 20-day average, buyers have started to push UNP higher again, but the rebound still needs to prove itself.
finalProse.whyItMatters: The first rebound from support is encouraging, but one strong day on its own does not confirm that the pullback is complete.
finalProse.setupLocation: Price is rebounding from the 20-day average inside a healthy trend, so the setup is still sitting near support rather than away from it.
finalProse.learningPoint: Strong trends often resume from the 20-day average, but waiting for buyers to follow through can reduce the risk of chasing a failed rebound.
finalProse.whatNext: Watch for price to hold above the 20-day average and build on the recent rebound. A failure back below support would weaken the setup.
